claims.quote: John Travolta has dismissed HBO's documentary "Going Clear: Scientology and the Prison of Belief" as negative and untrue
claims.reason: The evidence supports that Travolta called the documentary 'decidedly negative' and said he hasn't experienced anything the 'hearsay has claimed,' implying he views it as untrue. 'Negative' is directly supported; 'untrue' is a reasonable characterization of his statements.
claims.evidence_quote: I've been so happy with my (Scientology) experience in the last 40 years that I really don't have anything to say that would shed light on (a documentary) so decidedly negative
